tokenize_text_with_clip: tokenize a string or list of strings into CLIP token IDs using the tokenize function
create_simple_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance with a custom BPE vocab path and special tokens
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a text string into a list of BPE token IDs using SimpleTokenizer encode method
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of token IDs back into human-readable text using SimpleTokenizer decode method
use_clip_mask_tokenizer: create a ClipMaskTokenizer with a mask token for masked language modeling tasks
